title: 🎲 WearOS Dice App
content:
🎲 WearOS Dice App

It’s been a while since I last tried making a WearOS app. Last time I checked, the build process was painfully slow, and Android development itself is a bit of a headache 😅.

This time, I decided to make a simple dice app using ViewModel. Some dependencies need to be added in the build.gradle file — the editor won’t always remind you, but tools like Gemini can help find the right packages.

Sending the app to the watch is still a bit painful 😅. Right now I’m using wearos toolbox to install the APK, which makes life a little easier.
